description: Search Google Shopping live via SerpAPI. Returns shopping_results (product listings with title, price, merchant/source, rating, reviews, shipping and product/offer links) plus filters and related results. Set light=true to use the faster google_shopping_light engine (lower latency, but the response omits filters/carousel_filters and it misses some products the full engine finds — an empty light answer is retried once on the full engine; the result's `source` and `note` say so). `q` is required unless you pass a `shoprs` refinement token from a prior result. Prices reflect the chosen gl/locale.

free_shipping.description: Only show products offering free shipping. Default false.

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

google_domain.description: Google domain to use, e.g. 'google.com', 'google.co.uk', 'google.de'. Default google.com.

light.description: Use the faster google_shopping_light engine — response omits filters/carousel_filters and it misses some products the full engine finds, so an empty light answer is retried once on the full engine (`source` and `note` say so). When false (default) the full google_shopping engine is used.

location.description: Geographic location to originate the search from, e.g. 'Austin, Texas, United States'. Use a canonical Locations API name. Mutually exclusive with uule.

max_price.description: Maximum product price filter, in the local currency.

min_price.description: Minimum product price filter, in the local currency.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

on_sale.description: Only show products that are on sale. Default false.

q.description: Search query for products, e.g. 'coffee maker' or 'Nike Air Max'. Required unless shoprs is provided. Supports Google's advanced search operators.

shoprs.description: Refinement token from a prior result's filters/carousel_filters, used to apply a filter or refine the search. When set, q is optional.

small_business.description: Only show products from small businesses. Default false.

sort_by.description: Sort order: 1 = price low→high, 2 = price high→low. Omit for default relevance ranking.

start.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based, e.g. 0, 60, 120). Default 0.

uule.description: Google-encoded location string (the encoded form of a location). Mutually exclusive with location.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_shopping_search
title: Search Google Shopping (SerpAPI)
